note: Edits to the OSM layout for Pasatiempo, built into edited/course.geojson by pipeline/merge_edits.py (run by make course). Overnight build 2026-10-30/31: the developer was asleep and said to make the calls; every proposal here is tagged approved=pending and listed in validation_report.md (open items) and docs/courses/pasatiempo.md (developer's calls pending). To undo one, delete its entry and rebuild.

add.reason: The barrancas: OSM maps the creeks only as lines (Pasatiempo Creek w42855499 along 13's left, between 14/15 and 16 and short right of the 16th green; the unnamed stream w265532264 in the ravine in front of the 10th tee and the 18th green). Penalty areas from the channel the 2020 lidar DEM shows along them (propose_channels.py, then clip_channels.py: the boundary + 25 m), red (standing default; the club's card makes 18 yellow), flatten=no so the bed keeps falling. The club's local rules name penalty areas on 16 and 18 (and 11, below).

Hole 14 White tee. OSM maps w1041814063 as a bunker, but the NAIP photo shows a mown tee rectangle there (no sand), on the hole line 48 m ahead of the Gold tee; the 2020 lidar DEM also shows a raised levelled pad (propose_tees.py). From it the hole measures about 377 yd against 382 on the card. Made by make_tee14.py; the bunker is dropped below.

Hole 18: the long curved teeing ground w1041819911 runs 138-185 yd from the green centre; Gold (173) is in its back part, White (145) at its front tip. s06 gave the whole strip to Gold and played White from the line start (177 yd, +22 %). Cut across at 139 m (152 yd) from the green centre: front piece White, back piece Gold (make_tee18_split.py; the Cypress Point method). The pieces are the OSM box; nothing is drawn.

The practice range east of hole 1: OSM maps the 120 m mown strip w1041848694 and its hitting area r14043909 as golf=fairway belonging to no hole; the scouting has the club's range left of hole 1, out of bounds, and the NAIP photo shows the strip with a hitting area at the clubhouse end. Copied as golf=driving_range (make_range.py), so it is out of bounds (standing default).
